phasing_details.phase_detail: Phase 1- Internal reconfiguration and community space (internal) upgrades including WCs, accessibility improvements and associated M&E works (heating and electrical internal upgrades).
Phase 2 -  Internal thermal insulation upgrades, mansard stair extension and roof alterations.
Phase 3 ? External upgrades including window replacement, PV installation, new entrances/canopies, community caf? fit-out, landscaping, parking reconfiguration and SuDS works.

description: Refurbishment and alteration of existing church building, involving internal reconfiguration, installation of pv panels to pitched roofs at SW elevation, external consider units/air source heat pumps at NE elevation with fire door, replacement of 1st floor mansard extension to provide new stair access to balcony, sunken baptism pool, new community cafe and ancillary spaces at rear, installation of new and replacement external doors and windows, installation of new skylights, new entrance canopies to Fore Street and Brettenham Road, and external alterations including upgraded hard landscaping, cycle parking, disabled parking provision, and associated works.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. Location Plan EC-EX-00 September 2025;Existing Block Plan EC-EX-01 September 2025;Existing Roof Plan EC-EX-02 September 2025;Existing First Floor Plan EC-EX-03 September 2025;Existing Ground Floor Plan EC-EX-04 September 2025;Existing Basement Plan EC-EX-05 September 2025;Existing South West Elevation (Side - Prior to the commencement of the installation of the windows and doors hereby approved, detailed drawings at a scale between 1:1 and 1:20 by elevations and sections and manufactures specifications shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority; and notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, the new Fore Street doorway shall be of a symmetrical design aligned with the existing fenestration pattern and any projecting entrance frame/reveal shall be omitted.Reason: To ensure the satisfactory appearance of the development, preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area.

Prior to the installation of any of the following, full details and specifications shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority: the welcome canopies, the mansard roof extension, all external materials and finishes, external lighting, hard and soft landscaping, boundary treatments, photovoltaic panels, air source heat pumps, and any associated screening or enclosures. Such details shall include, where relevant, drawings, materials, product specifications, fixings, plant screening and attenuation, planting species, tree details, SuDS details and maintenance arrangements. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the satisfactory appearance of the development, preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area.

The external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall be constructed in the materials shown on the approved plans and supporting information.Reason: To ensure the satisfactory appearance of the development, preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area.

The development shall not commence until details of source control SuDS has been submitted and approved by the Local Authority. Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. REASON: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF and to maximise opportunities for sustainable development, improve water quality, biodiversity, local amenity and recreation value.

The access shall not be brought into use until visibility splays have been provided. The splays shall thereafter be maintained free of any obstruction exceeding 0.6 m in height within 2 m of either side of the access and across the full extent of the visibility splays. The development shall also demonstrate that the access and internal layout safely accommodate vehicle movements through the provision of appropriate vehicle tracking. Reason: To provide adequate visibility for drivers entering or leaving the site and to ensure the safety of pedestrians and vehicles.

The scheme shall incorporate measures for pedestrian safety, including a clearly defined and safe waiting  area, appropriate signage, route delineation, and adequate lighting.  Reason: To ensure that the access and site layout are designed to safely accommodate pedestrian movements and provide appropriate and secure facilities for pedestrians, thereby reducing the risk of conflict of pedestrians with cyclists and vehicles and ensuring safe operation of the development.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until space has been laid out within the site in accordance with drawing no. EC-PL-04 RevA for 8 bicycles to be parked and that space shall thereafter be kept available for the parking of bicycles.Reason: To ensure the provision of accessible, secure, and adequate cycle parking facilities and to safeguard the character and appearance of the area.

No plant or equipment shall be affixed to any external face of a building or added to the roof of a building other than that shown in the approved drawings.Reason: In the interest of amenity and to ensure a satisfactory external appearance in accordance with policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Policy (2014).

The community café hereby approved shall remain ancillary to the primary use of the premises as a place of worship and community facility and shall not be operated as an independent planning unit or separate primary use.Reason: To safeguard the continued use of the premises as a place of worship and community facility and to protect the amenities of surrounding occupiers.
